title: High Desert Art Fair
description: Annual boutique art fair at Pioneertown, adjacent to Joshua Tree National Park. A cultural signal node for the anti-commercial creative class migrating toward the desert region.
agent_summary: The High Desert Art Fair is an annual boutique art fair at Pioneertown adjacent to Joshua Tree National Park — a cultural infrastructure signal for the creative class considering desert relocation or retreat, with satellite programming at the Palm Springs Art Museum.
